_note: 英語の案。本人の確認の前は draft の印を画面に出す（J-030）。原文の手順の文を鍵にするので、原文が変わると試験（tests/test_en.py）が落ちて訳し直しが分かる。

H-A.name: A tab on the side pushes it up
H-A.how: Hold the tube and lift the tab that sticks out of the slot in the side.

H-B.name: Push the inner tube up from below
H-B.how: Hold the tube and push up the inner tube that sticks out at the bottom with your finger.

H-C.name: Push a handle up from below
H-C.how: Hold the tube and push up the chopstick handle that sticks out at the bottom.

H-D.name: Hold the handle and lower the tube
H-D.how: Hold the handle and lower the tube. The template is the same as idea C, and the movement is the opposite.

H-E.name: Set the fan on a platform at the mouth of the tube
H-E.how: Push up the inner tube, and the fan opens on a platform at the height of the mouth.

H-A.name: Put the neck in a hole in the body and let a weight inside swing it
H-A.how: Touch the head with a finger and let go.

H-B.name: Hang the head in front of the body
H-B.how: Touch the head with a finger and let go.

H-C.name: A light head swayed by wind
H-C.how: Fan it or blow on it.

steps.刷った物差しに定規を当て、10cm か確かめる: Put a ruler on the printed scale and check that it measures 10 cm.
steps.まず 1 外筒だけを実線で切る。溝は下の端からはさみで切り込む（くり抜かない）: First cut out only part 1 (outer tube) along the solid lines. Cut the slot in from the bottom edge with scissors (do not punch it out).
steps.1 外筒を色の境で谷折りし、糊代で貼って角筒にする: Valley-fold part 1 along the color boundaries and glue the tab to make a square tube.
steps.残りの部品を実線で切る。穴は竹串の先であける: Cut out the other parts along the solid lines. Make the holes with the tip of a skewer.
steps.2 内筒も同じように角筒にする: Make part 2 (inner tube) into a square tube the same way.
steps.竹串を 2 内筒の 2 つの穴に通す: Pass the skewer through the two holes in part 2.
steps.3 台で 2 の上に蓋をする: Cap the top of part 2 with part 3 (platform).
steps.4 扇を色の境で、端から谷折り・山折りを交互にして蛇腹に畳む: Starting from one end, fold part 4 (fan) along the color boundaries, alternating valley and mountain folds, into an accordion.
steps.糸を 5 像の穴と 4 扇の中心側の穴の列に通し、ゆるく結ぶ: Thread string through the hole in part 5 (figure) and the row of holes on the center side of part 4, and tie it loosely.
steps.4 扇の真ん中の足を、糊代の境の破線で折り、足の糊代を 3 台の印に貼る: Fold the middle foot of part 4 on the dashed line at the glue tab, and glue the tab to the mark on part 3.
steps.5 像の足を 3 台に貼る: Glue the foot of part 5 to part 3.
steps.内筒を 1 外筒に入れ、竹串の端を溝から出す: Put the inner tube into part 1 and let the ends of the skewer stick out through the slots.
steps.まず 1 外筒だけを実線で切る: First cut out only part 1 (outer tube) along the solid lines.
steps.押す部品を 1 外筒に下から入れる: Put the pushing part into part 1 from below.
steps.2 土台も同じように角筒にし、割り箸の先を下から差し込んで貼る: Make part 2 (base) into a square tube the same way, then push the tip of a disposable chopstick in from below and glue it.
steps.4 扇の端を 3 台に貼り、5 像の足も台に貼る: Glue the end of part 4 to part 3, and glue the foot of part 5 to the platform too.
steps.部品を実線で切る。胴の穴は竹串の先であける: Cut out the parts along the solid lines. Make the holes in the body with the tip of a skewer.
steps.1 胴の前の壁の四角い穴を切る（カッターは大人がする）: Cut the square hole in the front wall of part 1 (body). An adult should use the craft knife.
steps.1 胴を破線で谷折りし、糊代で貼って箱にする。上の面は後で閉じる: Valley-fold part 1 on the dashed lines and glue the tabs to make a box. Close the top later.
steps.1 胴を線のとおり山折りし、糊代で貼って箱にする。上の面は後で閉じる: Mountain-fold part 1 along the lines and glue the tabs to make a box. Close the top later.
steps.5 重りの腕の上の穴にも竹串を通す。下の穴（点の線）の所に粘土を付ける。腕は 3: Also pass the skewer through the upper hole of part 5 (weight arm). Put the clay at the lower hole (on the dotted line). Lay the arm along part 3 (neck strip) and hold it there for now with tape (do not glue it yet).
steps.頭の傾きを見て腕の位置を決めてから、腕を 3 首の帯に貼る: Watch how the head tilts, decide where the arm should go, and then glue the arm to part 3 (neck strip).
steps.3 首の帯を半分に折って貼る。穴は重ねたまま通す: Fold part 3 (neck strip) in half and glue it, keeping the holes lined up and open.
steps.3 首の帯の前の端に 2 頭を貼る: Glue part 2 (head) to the front end of part 3.
steps.帯を前の壁の穴に入れ、竹串を胴の穴と帯の穴に通す: Put the strip into the hole in the front wall, and pass a skewer through the holes in the body and the strip.
steps.5 重りの腕の穴にも竹串を通し、下の端に粘土を付ける。腕は 3 首の帯に貼る: Pass the skewer through the hole in part 5 (weight arm) too, and put clay on its lower end. Glue the arm to part 3.
steps.頭の傾きを見て、腕を貼る位置を決める: Watch how the head tilts to decide where to glue the arm.
steps.4 尾を丸くして、後ろに貼る: Curl part 4 (tail) and glue it to the back.
steps.3 首の帯の下の端を、2 頭の上の端に 4mm 重ねて貼る: Glue the lower end of part 3 to the top edge of part 2, overlapping by 4 mm.
steps.竹串を耳の穴と帯の穴に通す: Pass the skewer through the holes in the ears and the strip.
steps.粘土を頭の裏の真ん中、頭の上の端から 20mm 下に貼る: Stick clay on the middle of the back of the head, 20 mm below its top edge.
